notes: CDRI homepage and its 'Mainstreaming Resilience into Infrastructure' study (April 2026): India projected to spend $4.51 trillion on infrastructure by 2030 toward its $5 trillion economy vision; natural hazards pose risk of losses up to $1.02 trillion. Study covers roads, railways, power; introduces a Resilience Cost-Benefit Analysis (RCBA) tool (up to $12 benefit per $1 invested) and a Disaster Resilience Toolkit for ministries and bidders. CDRI reports 70 members, 183 projects, $21.84 mn funding disbursed.
recommended_action: Position HydraShield exposure/economy intelligence as a data layer for CDRI's RCBA and toolkit workstreams; offer multi-hazard risk screening for Indian infrastructure portfolios.
